name: ZclockID Enterprise v1.1.4
summary: Standardized toggle switch colors (red OFF / green ON) and hardened BIND9 RPZ overrides
notes:
### What's Changed in v1.1.4:
* **Unified Toggle Switch Appearance:** Standardized all dashboard and settings switches (NTP, MS-SNTP signing, Azure Sync, SNMP Daemon, SNMP Telemetry, Syslog Forwarding, Self-Registration, Mobile OTP, SMTP Notifications, Firewall) to intuitive red (`bg-rose-600`) when OFF and green (`peer-checked:bg-emerald-600`) when ON.
* **BIND9 RPZ Overrides Hardening:** Ensured `/etc/bind/named.conf.overrides` and local response policy zone are automatically provisioned and included in `named.conf`, preventing named daemon failures on fresh installs or override updates.
* **AD Functional Level Architecture Clarifications:** Documented Samba 4 Active Directory Domain Controller baseline (Windows Server 2008 R2 DFL/FFL with Windows Server 2016/2019 schema extensions) in Domain Management and elevation modal.
